rawRequest: Org-level LLM usage screen: let an Org Admin or Editor see requests, tokens and cost over a chosen period, broken down by identity, billing service, billing account, model and provider (paraphrased from the source epic, user story US-02).
audience: Org Admin / Editor managing LLM budget inside one organization
context: Admin console of an LLM gateway; one screen inside an existing admin shell (shell, tokens and language not supplied)
primaryOutcome: Find which consumer, service, model or provider drives usage and cost in the chosen period
primaryAction: Change time range or filter, then read the breakdown
requiredContent: Summary cards: request count, input tokens, output tokens, total tokens, cost
Usage-over-time chart and a breakdown table for the same range
Time range control accepting an arbitrary range
Filters: identity, billing service, billing account, model, provider
constraints: Read-only; scoped to the actor's own organization
No alerting, quota, limit, anomaly or forecast surfaces
No trace, log, health or latency views
prohibitedClaims: Do not present estimated cost as a billed amount

criteria.text: All five metrics visible without scrolling on a 1440px viewport
Chart and table always reflect the same range and filter set
Empty, loading and full states each render and pass the gates
Usable at 375px without horizontal page scroll

assumptions.value: No existing shell available; this repo's own tokens stand in
Plain 'no usage in this period' with a range-reset action
Request status filter omitted (named in the flow, absent from the story)
Out of this screen set (not in the story's criteria)
Org-level admin console screen, not a landing page
